params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.row_type
params.description: Indicates the field names and types for the rows in the result set. For example, a SQL query like "SELECT UserId, UserName FROM Users" could return a row_type value like: "fields": [ { "name": "UserId", "type": { "code": "INT64" } }, { "name": "UserName", "type": { "code": "STRING" } }, ]

params.name: data.transaction
params.description: If the read or SQL query began a transaction as a side-effect, the information about the new transaction is yielded here.
